strengths.value: Tuning-free plug-and-play 2-bit KV cache quantization with little to no accuracy drop on Llama and Mistral.

ev.quote: KIVI can efficiently compress KV cache to 2bit and bring 2.6× peak memory usage reduction for Llama-2-7B, with little to no accuracy drop.

strengths.value: Asymmetric design backed by analysis: key cache per-channel, value cache per-token, with empirical and theoretical justification.

ev.quote: Extensive analysis regarding the outlier patterns and quantization error of KV cache in commonlyused LLMs. Our observations suggest that key cache should be quantized per-channel and value cache should be quantized per-token.

strengths.value: Hardware-friendly CUDA / Triton kernels enable up to 4x larger batch and 2.35-3.47x throughput on A100.

ev.quote: KIVI enables up to 4× larger batch size and gives 2.35×∼3.47× larger throughput.

strengths.value: Full-precision residual sliding window keeps recent tokens accurate, helping hard tasks like GSM8K.

ev.quote: this full precision sliding window is crucial for obtaining desirable performance on hard tasks, such as GSM8K.

weaknesses.value: Falcon-7B (multi-query attention) loses much accuracy at 2-bit; only 4-bit KIVI keeps quality there.

ev.quote: in Table 3, 4bit KIVI is needed to maintain the accuracy, while 2bit KIVI may have a large accuracy drop in this case.

weaknesses.value: Quantization process is not yet fused with previous operations, leaving extra speedup unrealized.

ev.quote: this speed-up can be greatly increased if we further fuse the KV cache quantization process with previous operations. We leave it as one of future work.

weaknesses.value: Closed-end tasks like MMLU are not evaluated because they only have one decoding step.

ev.quote: The closed-end tasks such as MMLU are not ideal to evaluate KIVI since they only involve one decoding step

limitations.value: Only quantizes KV cache; weights and activations are left untouched in this work.

ev.quote: Our method is fully compatible with weight-only quantization.

limitations.value: No safety, bias, or jailbreak evaluation after quantization.
Evaluated only on a single data-center A100 GPU, no edge or mobile hardware tests.
